hooks.text: 传送怪会跳过长通道，融合怪会在堵口合体，敌人专门反制传统迷宫套路
hooks.excerpt: Build long hallways? Porters will teleport across them instantly, right past your beautiful turrets! Build nice choke points? Fusers will combine into super creeps of overwhelming power!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三维战场允许从上下、墙面甚至天花板交火，炮塔还必须满足真实视线
hooks.excerpt: Fight creeps from above, below, on the walls, or even on the ceiling! Gravity is only a suggestion. GO BALLISTIC! Every bullet, bomb, beam, and blaster is fully simulated in the third dimension! Turrets need line-of-sight to fire, so down in front!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 主动加速刷怪可换取更多建造资源，但怪群过密会进化并反噬防线
hooks.excerpt: If you’re feeling cocky, you can speed up the spawn rate by rushing waves. Rushed creeps award you with more resources you can use to build more turrets and rush more creeps! Just be careful with your greed finger. If the creep swarm gets too overpopulated, they will mutate into evolved forms and ruin your day.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
